name: Beijing Tianma Intelligent Control Technology CO., LTD.
summary: Beijing Tianma Intelligent Control Technology CO., LTD. engages in the research and development, production, sale, and service of unmanned intelligent mining control technology and equipment for coal mines in China. The company offers SAM-type automated mining control systems; SAC type hydraulic support electro-hydraulic control systems; and SAP-type intelligent integrated liquid supply systems. It also provides control systems, fluid supply equipment, and precise position and posture control systems for fully mechanized mining equipment; spare parts; operation and maintenance services; and solutions and equipment for the construction needs of intelligent factories in discrete manufacturing …
